name: floating-points-club
north_star: Adam's Floating Points: tight 129-136 BPM flat-minor CLUB cuts with a pedal-tone hammer (one note repeated obsessively, broken by octave/P5 leaps) — not wandering ambient
reference: Floating Points · LesAlpx / Key103 (F min / 129-136 BPM, pedal-tone melody, patient builds, extreme dynamics)
caption: modular analog electronic club track, Buchla synthesizer, hypnotic single-note pedal-tone melody repeated obsessively with octave leaps, four on the floor kick, euclidean syncopated percussion, patient build from near silence, glitching melodies drifting slightly in pitch, jazzy flat-key colour, euphoric release
script:
